baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَوَّاحَةٌ (ل و ح) is joined by لِـ to الْبَشَرِ (ب ش ر), and both roots carry a visible-surface reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: Intensive heat or exposure alters the outer human surface, so the short predicate names an agent or process that repeatedly makes its effect legible on skin.

activation_trace.role: The heat-or-exposure mark supplies the altering force and makes لَوَّاحَةٌ an intensive surface-marker.
The visible outer-skin branch supplies the affected surface rather than only the collective audience.

changed_reading.before: A bright or scorching thing directed toward people.
changed_reading.after: An intensive heat-borne marker that changes the visible human skin.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The appearance branch of ل و ح can govern الْبَشَرِ as humankind through the لِـ construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: Something flashes into view in a way addressed to humanity; visibility, rather than bodily damage, is the operative relation.

activation_trace.role: The glinting-into-view image supplies conspicuous appearance as the predicate's action.
The human-being branch supplies the public audience before whom the appearance occurs.

changed_reading.after: A conspicuous apparition or flashing display before humankind.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَوَّاحَةٌ remains attached to its ل و ح inventory, while لِلْبَشَرِ supplies the human addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: The predicate can function as an alarm that arouses caution or concern for humans, with luminosity or heat secondary to the warning response.

activation_trace.role: The caution, pity, or alarm branch supplies an affective warning function for the predicate.
The humankind branch identifies those whom the alarm concerns or addresses.

changed_reading.before: A physical light or heat affecting humans.
changed_reading.after: An alarm concerning humankind that is meant to awaken caution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The nominal form لَوَّاحَةٌ can activate the ل و ح branch of a broad tablet or plank beside the visible-surface branch of ب ش ر.
baseline_models.mechanism: A broad bearing surface is oriented toward human visibility, producing a display or inscription model rather than a purely thermal one.

activation_trace.role: The broad tablet or plank supplies a plane capable of bearing and displaying a trace.
The visible-surface branch lets human skin itself become the display-bearing plane.

changed_reading.before: A bright or burning agent for people.
changed_reading.after: A broad public display, potentially using the human surface as its bearing plane.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding sequence supplies encounter with fire, negated remainder, negated leaving, and blazing fire that brands. These turn the baseline skin mark into a totalizing, repeated thermal action rather than a cosmetic discoloration.

activation_trace.role: The heat-mark branch anchors the resulting action in visible alteration by exposure.
The outer-skin branch identifies the repeatedly affected human surface.
Encountering fire and its heat supplies the immediate thermal cause.
The remainder branch is negated in context, supplying non-preservation of any residue.
The leaving branch is likewise negated, intensifying the action's exhaustive reach.
Blazing fire and branding by it join heat, fire, and a visible imposed mark in one mechanism.

structural_cues: 74:26-29 is a contiguous progression from entry into Saqar through non-preservation and non-leaving to the focus predicate.
74:31 names the relevant fire immediately after the focus and its count.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies heat, total-negation language, and fire-branding; I supply the causal arrow from that fire to repeated alteration of exposed skin. A live alternative is that the focus describes a visible warning rather than the body's treatment.

changed_reading.before: Heat leaves a visible mark on skin.
changed_reading.after: Saqar's fire repeatedly brands and consumes the exposed human surface, with no remainder exempted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact relation لِلْبَشَرِ recurs with reminder and warning. This makes the skin and humankind senses cooperate: a visible effect on human surface can itself function as the public warning to humanity.

activation_trace.role: The heat-mark image supplies the bodily side of the double address.
The glinting-into-view image supplies the mark's public visibility.
Visible outer skin supplies the material surface on which the warning appears.
Humankind supplies the collective audience to whom the same appearance is addressed.
The repeated humankind phrase fixes a public addressee beyond the narrower skin sense.
The reminder branch gives the visible phenomenon a mnemonic and admonitory function.
Warning that awakens caution states the function of the repeated address to humankind.

structural_cues: The construction لِلْبَشَرِ occurs at 74:29, 74:31, and 74:36.
The latter two occurrences explicitly classify what is for humankind as reminder and warning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated construction and the skin, humanity, reminder, and warning branches; I infer that the repetitions functionally gloss the focus while preserving its surface pun. They could instead be parallel statements with no intended lexical fusion.

changed_reading.before: Either a skin-scorcher or a flash shown to people.
changed_reading.after: A visible mark on human skin whose very visibility serves as reminder and warning to humankind.

context_deltas.mechanism: A sequence of looking, facial reaction, and reduction to transmitted human speech is answered by a lasting visible trace on the human surface; later bodily turning-away confirms that the sign operates as a visual address that can be refused.

activation_trace.role: The visible effect left by exposure supplies the answering bodily trace.
The visible skin or surface makes the answer materially legible.
Directed sight initiates the observer's attempted control of what the sign means.
A lasting mark that indicates what occurred converts the claim of transmission into a trace borne by the claimant.
Spoken utterance supplies the reductive verdict that the focus reverses from speech into visible consequence.
The earlier label of human speech becomes the focus's human audience and vulnerable bearer.
Turning one's side away supplies the bodily refusal elicited by an otherwise visible address.

structural_cues: 74:18-25 moves from inward calculation to looking, facial reaction, and a spoken verdict before 74:26-29 gives the consequence.
74:49 later describes a bodily orientation away from the reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the visual-verbal sequence, the lasting-trace branch, the repeated human term, and later turning-away; I supply the retaliatory arrow by which the dismissed utterance becomes a mark on its dismissive observer. The sequence can also be read without this rhetorical reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: A physical skin mark or a public warning.
changed_reading.after: A rhetorical reversal in which the observer's verdict of 'human speech' returns as an inescapable visible trace on the human bearer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Moonlight, departing night, and dawn brightening a face or light-stage recast لَوَّاحَةٌ as a threshold disclosure: hidden consequence comes into view the way a surface emerges at daybreak.

activation_trace.role: Glinting into view anchors the focus in an event of appearance rather than generic brightness.
The visible surface supplies what disclosure renders legible.
The moon and its sky-light supply a first nocturnal visibility field.
Night and darkness supply the prior concealment against which appearance registers.
The ending and passing of a thing supplies darkness's withdrawal.
Dawn and the first of day supply the temporal threshold of disclosure.
The brightening of light or face maps disclosure directly onto a visible human surface.

structural_cues: The moon-night-dawn oath sequence follows immediately after the focus's explanatory continuation in 74:30-31.
The sequence moves from limited light through receding darkness to unveiled morning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a temporal light sequence and the face-brightening branch; I infer that it images how the focus becomes perceptible. A live alternative is that the oaths only attest to the warning and do not describe its visual mechanics.

changed_reading.before: A static bright display for people.
changed_reading.after: A threshold event that unveils hidden consequence and makes it legible on the human surface.

context_deltas.mechanism: The counted sign is called an assay and produces certainty, doubt, or diseased questioning. Visibility therefore does diagnostic work: one external exposure differentiates hidden inner conditions, making لَوَّاحَةٌ an epistemic as well as thermal revealer.

activation_trace.role: Appearance into view supplies the common external stimulus presented to observers.
The branch joining outer and inner qualities supplies the human interface through which hidden condition is tested.
Assaying metal or a person supplies the diagnostic mechanism linking exposure to revealed quality.
Settled knowledge with doubt removed supplies one product of the assay.
Agitated doubt supplies the contrasting response exposed by the same sign.
The core or innermost part locates the hidden quality being differentiated.
Darkening and loss of clarity supplies the impaired inner condition that the visible test exposes.

structural_cues: Within 74:31, one stated test yields several explicitly contrasted responses.
The focus's visible predicate stands immediately before that response-sorting explanation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay, certainty, doubt, inner core, and obscured clarity; I infer the arrow from a common visible exposure to differentiated inner revelation. This need not mean that belief states are literally written on skin.

changed_reading.before: A uniform physical effect or warning addressed to all humans.
changed_reading.after: A visible assay that reveals divergent inner conditions by the responses it draws from humans.

context_deltas.mechanism: Book, binding document, written sheet, and opened publication strengthen the tablet branch of ل و ح. Joined to the visible human surface, the focus can image consequence as an embodied record opened to view.

activation_trace.role: The broad writing tablet or plank supplies the record-bearing plane.
Visible outer skin supplies an embodied surface on which the record can appear.
Ordered letters and the written object establish the surah's explicit documentary register.
A document held against a right gives the visible record binding evidentiary force.
The written sheet supplies the demanded individualized medium of disclosure.
Published or opened writing supplies the transition from stored record to public evidence.

structural_cues: 74:38 binds each self to what it has acquired, while 74:52 demands individually opened sheets.
Documentary language occurs on both sides of the later accountability dialogue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tablet, written objects, a binding document, and opened sheets; I supply the metaphorical identification of human skin with the displayed record of consequence. The safer alternative keeps bodily marking and textual imagery separate.

changed_reading.before: A broad display or tablet placed before humans.
changed_reading.after: The exposed human surface becomes an opened, binding record on which consequence is publicly legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah begins with outer covering and garment, names truth-covering, then stages removal of a veil and ends with protective warding and covering. Against that network, the focus marks the exposed surface: false concealment is stripped, while true protection remains the opposite possibility.

activation_trace.role: Exposure leaving a visible alteration supplies what occurs when the surface is no longer shielded.
Outer skin supplies the boundary across which covering or exposure matters.
An outer wrap supplies the opening state of bodily covering.
Garment and covering, also capable of standing for the self, extend the surface boundary into conduct.
Covering or concealment supplies the resistant form of hiding that exposure opposes.
Removing a cover supplies the transition from concealment to visible consequence.
Placing the self in protection supplies a constructive shield distinct from concealment.
A covering that preserves supplies the final protective opposite of destructive exposure.

structural_cues: Covering and garment language opens the surah, while warding and preserving cover close it.
The focus lies between resistant concealment and the later dawn image of removed covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies several materially distinct coverings and one uncovering; I classify concealment and protective cover as opposed functions and place the focus at their exposed boundary. They may instead be independent lexical motifs with no designed arc.

changed_reading.before: Heat happens to mark bare skin.
changed_reading.after: The mark is the visible condition of failed concealment and absent protection, contrasted with the preserving cover offered at the surah's end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The form-distant alarm branch gains a full response chain: warning should awaken caution, but the audience recoils and flees, while fear becomes visible on the human person. The focus is thus an affect-producing signal as well as a light or burn.

activation_trace.role: Caution, pity, or alarm anchors the focus's affective signal.
Humankind supplies the alarm's addressed population.
A warning that frightens and awakens caution states the signal's intended effect.
Recoiling and distancing supplies the audience's first contrary reaction.
Flight and escape complete the behavioral response to the alarm.
Fear appearing on a human supplies an outwardly legible affective mark.

structural_cues: 74:36 explicitly calls the preceding complex a warning for humankind.
74:49-53 moves from turning away to recoil, flight, and denial of fear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, recoil, flight, and visibly embodied fear; I connect them as stimulus and response to the focus's alarm branch. The alternative is that لَوَّاحَةٌ remains purely thermal while later flight illustrates response independently.

changed_reading.before: An isolated lexical possibility of an alarm for humans.
changed_reading.after: A visible alarm whose intended caution is converted by resistance into recoil, flight, and fear showing on the human bearer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates pastoral thirst and watering branches inside the immediately following numeral roots. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit rapid-thirst branch and exact 74:30 roots, but downstream prose must present it only as a lexical-material echo, never as a replacement translation or a claim that nineteen encodes a watering schedule.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَوَّاحَةٌ activates the ل و ح image of thirst that quickly overtakes its bearer, with البشر as the human bearer.

activation_trace.role: Thirst arriving quickly supplies an alternative bodily effect of the focus predicate.
The human-being branch supplies the one overtaken by thirst.
A camel thirst-cycle reckoned by nine supplies an immediate measured-thirst resonance.
Camels reaching water on the tenth supplies the paired watering horizon of that resonance.

changed_reading.before: The focus concerns only heat, brightness, or warning.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the focus can evoke rapidly imposed thirst followed by the next verse's measured thirst-and-watering vocabulary.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant and cross-domain: a hunting decoy, snares, recoil, and pursuit do not license identifying Saqar with a literal owl or trap. It remains worth carrying because every step is branch-backed and the focus stays the conspicuous lure; downstream prose should qualify it strictly as an attention-and-flight analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ل و ح inventory includes a decoy owl rigged to draw down a raptor, while لِلْبَشَرِ keeps humans as the affected field.

activation_trace.role: The conspicuous decoy owl supplies a lure that exposes the approaching quarry.
Humankind supplies the analogical quarry whose response is drawn into view.
Snares and traps supply the capture side of the exploratory hunting mechanism.
Recoiling away supplies the exposed quarry's immediate reaction.
The pursuing qaswara supplies the chase pressure that turns recoil into flight.

changed_reading.before: A static burner or warning sign.
changed_reading.after: As an analogy, a conspicuous lure-like signal draws resistant humans into exposure, recoil, and pursuit.

strongest_changes: Immediate fire, non-remainder, non-leaving, and branding cues strengthen the heat-mark reading into totalizing surface consumption.
The repeated لِلْبَشَرِ with reminder and warning fuses the skin-effect and public-address readings instead of forcing a choice between them.
The dawn sequence and the test-response explanation recast visibility as disclosure and assay.
Book, pledge, and opened-sheet imagery strengthens the exploratory model of the human surface as an embodied record.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's two roots can jointly carry material skin, collective humanity, visible appearance, and warning. Whole-surah repetitions do not eliminate that polysemy; they organize it into a mechanism in which consequence appears on a human surface and thereby addresses, tests, and warns humans.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact bearer of the feminine predicate remains implicit in 74:29 even though the immediate sequence strongly associates it with Saqar and fire.
It remains uncertain whether البشر is chiefly skin, humankind, or a deliberately sustained double activation.
The embodied-document, thirst-cycle, and hunting-decoy readings are visibly anchored but remain branch-distant analogies rather than stable lexical construals.
